control.description-key: A clean, professional Kanban board for any view. Group records by a choice column, drag cards between columns, see per-column totals.

data-set.name: records
data-set.description-key: The view records shown as cards

property-set.name: title
property-set.description-key: Column used as the card title

property-set.name: groupBy
property-set.description-key: Choice/OptionSet column that defines the Kanban columns

property-set.name: cardValue
property-set.description-key: Currency column shown on the card and summed per column

property-set.name: cardValueBase
property-set.description-key: Optional. The matching (Base) column of Card Value, e.g. Est. Revenue (Base). Used for the column totals so multi-currency records can be added up. Left empty, the control finds it automatically.

property-set.name: cardDate
property-set.description-key: Date column shown on the card (highlighted red when overdue)

property-set.name: extraField1
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property-set.name: extraField2
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property-set.name: extraField3
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property-set.name: extraField4
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property-set.name: extraField5
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property-set.name: extraField6
property-set.description-key: Pick any column to show as a row on the card

property.name: ownerColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of the owner/lookup column to show as an avatar. The column must be included in the view. Default: ownerid

property.name: validateBpf
property.description-key: Yes = a card cannot leave a stage while that Business Process Flow stage has empty required fields. Only applies when the table has an activated BPF whose stage names match the column labels.

property.name: boardHeight
property.description-key: Fixed height of the board in pixels. Default: 720
